fusions.name: Dressage Finish
fusions.desc: A measured strike at a target at or below 25% health that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Unravelling] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Pirouette on the Haunches
fusions.desc: You turn on your haunches, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stripping 10% armour for 4 seconds and slowing each by 20%. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Drilled Cadence
fusions.desc: Your casting speed rises 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Counted Paces
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 10. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
